title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (18/20): Digging a Subway Tunnel
note_en: 是否 (shìfǒu) means "whether" and introduces a yes-or-no question embedded in a larger sentence: 监测地面是否发生沉降 "check whether the ground is sinking." Like "whether," it comes right before the part being questioned, but unlike English it slots in after the subject (地面是否…). In speech you would use the verb-not-verb form instead: 有没有沉降.
